segments.name: Small US recruiting agencies
segments.description: Agencies with 5 to 50 recruiters placing candidates in hourly, technical, or professional roles
characteristics: Uses an ATS for candidates and job orders
Runs intake and screening calls on video or phone
High call volume with few operations staff
pain_points: Follow-up actions are lost after a call

personas.name: Agency owner
pain_points: Retyping notes into the ATS takes time

personas.name: Senior recruiter
goals: Spend less time on call admin
pain_points: Manual note writing after each intake call

personas.name: Recruiting coordinator
pain_points: Cleans notes and moves candidates between stages
Follow-up actions are lost after a call
Retyping notes into the ATS takes time
Candidate requirements are hard to compare across roles
buying_triggers: New client volume exceeds current staff capacity
A recruiter leaves and notes are incomplete
The agency adopts a new ATS and wants clean data
A client asks for faster candidate summaries
ideal_customer_profile: US recruiting agency with 5 to 50 recruiters that places candidates in hourly, technical, or professional roles and runs intake and screening calls on video or phone.

claims.text: The best first buyer is an agency owner who also manages a small recruiter team.
The coordinator feels the rework, and the owner sees the cost.
Agencies will accept a paid pilot within 90 days.

assumptions: Agencies will accept a paid pilot within 90 days
ATS vendors allow write access through a supported interface
limitations: No interviews or surveys were run for this reference trial
The retention period agencies require for call recordings is unknown
